Data completeness: full month, real administrative boundary — 2525 recorded incidents for 2026-06, queried against Redbridge's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for that exact area. Day score: 2.6732 weighted incidents/1,000 people (105% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 13.8061 weighted incidents/1,000 people (108% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 238,931 (2021 resident population of 310,300, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Redbridge — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.
